meta.index_title: LiftSmart — Lift log & training program for iPhone
meta.index_description: LiftSmart is a lift log and an adaptive training program in one. Answer a few questions, get a multi-week program built for your goal, log every set and let the plan adjust to your feedback.

hero.kicker: Lift log & training program for iPhone
hero.lede: Answer a few questions and get a multi-week program built around your goal. Every session tells you what to lift, how many reps to aim for and how hard to push — and your feedback shapes next week.
hero.note: Free to start · Pro subscription for Guided training
hero.alt_main: LiftSmart Guided training home showing the current program week
hero.alt_left: Explore screen with ready-made training plans
hero.alt_right: Training history calendar with worked muscles

features_head.p: A program that adapts to you, a log that fills itself while you train, and 300 exercises you can actually learn from.

blocks.p: Tell LiftSmart your goal, schedule, equipment and the muscles you want to focus on. It builds a multi-week program — or you start from one of 138 ready-made plans.
bullets: Weekly progression: targets move as you get stronger
Weekly effort (RIR) targets so you know how hard to push
Feedback after each exercise shapes next week's session
Deloads scheduled when you need them
blocks.alt: A guided session with prescribed sets, reps and effort targets

blocks.p: Browse multi-week plans and standalone workouts by level, goal and equipment. Save the ones you like into folders and start them any day.
bullets: Multi-week plans for muscle, strength and fat loss
Standalone workouts for days without a program
Folders to keep your favourites in order
blocks.alt: Explore screen listing training plans with level and goal filters

blocks.p: A video demonstration, worked-muscle map and equipment for every movement — plus About, How to do it and Tips, so you never search mid-set.
bullets: About, How to do it and Tips
Search and filter by muscle group
blocks.alt: Exercise details with video, muscles worked and step-by-step guidance

blocks.p: Whatever you train — a guided session, a plan or a quick workout — it lands in one history. Personal records are detected automatically.
bullets: Calendar of every session with weekly totals
Personal records at every rep range
Rest timers with Live Activities on your Lock Screen
blocks.alt: History calendar with weekly totals and a worked-muscles map

free.h_b: Go Pro when you want a program.
free.p: The log is free for good. LiftSmart Pro unlocks Guided training and unlimited saved workouts, monthly or yearly.

cards.p: Pick exercises and lift — no program required. Rest timers, set logging and a summary at the end.
Every set you log, kept for good: calendar, per-exercise history, volume by muscle group.
Detected automatically the moment you beat one, at every rep count.
The whole library with guidance is free, including search and muscle filters.
Save up to four workouts free. Pro removes the limit.
Guided training — personalised programs and every multi-week plan — plus unlimited saved workouts.

items.q: How is LiftSmart different from a workout tracker?
items.a: A tracker records what you did. LiftSmart also decides what you do next: it builds the program, sets weekly targets and adjusts them from your feedback. The tracker part is included and free.

items.q: Do I need experience to use it?
items.a: No. The questionnaire asks your level, and beginner plans start light and progress gradually. Every exercise has a video and step-by-step guidance.

items.q: Do I have to follow a program?
items.a: No. Quick workouts let you pick exercises and lift with no program at all, and everything still lands in your history.

items.q: What does Pro cost, and what is free?
items.a: Logging, history, personal records, the exercise library and up to four saved workouts are free forever. LiftSmart Pro unlocks Guided training and unlimited saved workouts. Prices are shown in the app in your local currency, monthly or yearly.
No. You can start as a guest. Sign in with Apple or Google keeps your data safe if you switch phones or reinstall.
iPhone running iOS 26 or later. Rest timers show as Live Activities on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

items.q: Is my data sold or used for ads?
items.a: No. There are no ads, no data sales and no tracking across other apps. Details are in the Privacy Policy.

cta.p: Your goal. Your program. Your log.
cta.fine: Made for iPhone · iOS 26 or later · Free to start, Pro subscription for Guided training

sections.title: 2. Accounts
sections.html:
• You can use LiftSmart as a guest (an anonymous account stored on our servers) or register with Sign in with Apple or Google. Registering preserves your data across devices and reinstalls; a guest account may be unrecoverable if you lose access to the device or delete the app.

sections.html:
LiftSmart is not medical advice. The workouts, programs, weights, repetitions and progression suggestions in the app are general fitness information generated from your own logged training. They are not a substitute for advice from a physician, physiotherapist or qualified coach.

  • Consult a doctor before starting any exercise program, especially if you have a medical condition, injury, or have been inactive.
  • Strength training carries inherent risk of injury. You are solely responsible for exercising within your abilities, using proper form and appropriate equipment, and stopping if something feels wrong.
  • Progression suggestions are estimates based on the numbers you log — always apply your own judgment before adding weight.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How LiftSmart collects, uses and protects your data.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data the LiftSmart iOS app ("LiftSmart", "we", "us") collects, why we collect it, and the choices you have. The short version: we collect what is needed to run your training, we do not sell your data, we do not show ads, and you can delete everything at any time from inside the app.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
sections.html:
Account data

  • Registered accounts (Sign in with Apple or Google): your email address and display name as provided by the sign-in provider, account creation and last-login timestamps, and how the account authenticates.
  • Guest accounts: you can use LiftSmart without registering. A guest account is an anonymous identifier with no email or name attached. If you later register, your training data moves to the registered account.

Profile data you provide

  • Bodyweight and your preferred weight unit (kg/lb) — used to log bodyweight exercises and prescribe loads.
  • Gender (optional) — used only to tailor which programs the app shows you.
  • Training preferences from onboarding and the program questionnaire: goal, experience level, schedule, equipment and muscle focus.
  • Profile photo (optional, registered accounts only) — a photo you choose with the system photo picker. The app receives only that photo, never your library. It stores a small square copy (at most 512×512 pixels) without location or camera details, and uses it only to show on your profile.

Training data

  • Workouts, plans and programs you create or start, the sets, reps, weights and durations you log, the feedback you give after exercises, session history, and personal records derived from it.
  • Custom exercises you create (name, muscle groups, equipment, optional video link).

Purchase data

  • Subscription status (whether your account has an active LiftSmart Pro entitlement). Payment itself is processed entirely by Apple — we never see your payment details.

Feedback

  • If you send feedback from the app, we receive the message you write and, for registered accounts, the email associated with your account so we can reply.

Usage and diagnostic data

  • Anonymous app usage events — screens viewed, features used (for example that a workout was completed and how long it took), app version and device model. See Analytics.
  • Crash reports and performance data (for example that the app crashed, on which screen, with which app version and device model). These are linked to your account identifier so we can fix problems that affect you; they contain no training content.
  • A device-integrity check (Apple App Attest) that confirms requests come from a genuine copy of the app. It sends no personal data.

Apart from the profile photo you choose to add, we do not collect photos. We also do not collect your location, contacts, health-app data or the advertising identifier (IDFA), and the app contains no advertising.

sections.title: 2. How we use it
sections.html:
• To provide the service: store and sync your training data, build and adjust your program, show your history and records.
  • To personalize: match the catalog to your preferences, schedule and (if provided) gender.
  • To operate subscriptions: check whether your account is entitled to LiftSmart Pro.
  • To improve the app: understand which features are used through aggregated usage analytics, and find and fix crashes.
  • To respond when you contact us.

Where the GDPR applies, we rely on the performance of our contract with you (providing the app), your consent (optional data such as gender), and our legitimate interest in improving and securing the service.

sections.title: 3. Who we share it with
sections.html:
We share data only with trusted service providers that make the app work on our behalf — providers of sign-in, secure cloud data storage, subscription management, crash reporting and usage analytics. Apple processes all payments, and if you sign in with Apple or Google, those providers handle the authentication. All data is transmitted and stored in encrypted form.

We do not sell or rent personal data, and we do not share it with advertisers or data brokers.

sections.title: 4. Analytics
sections.html: We collect anonymous usage analytics to understand how the app is used — for example which screens are opened, that workouts are started and completed, and whether onboarding is finished. Analytics data is tied to a random app-instance identifier, not to your name or email. We do not use the advertising identifier (IDFA), do not use analytics for advertising, and do not track you across other companies' apps or websites.

sections.title: 5. Retention and deletion
sections.html:
• Your data is kept for as long as your account exists.
  • Deleting your account removes your profile and all training data from our servers, revokes the Sign in with Apple token where applicable, and deletes the authentication record. You can do this in the app under Profile → Delete account — see the step-by-step instructions.
  • Your profile photo is deleted from our servers when you remove or replace it in the app, and when you delete your account.
  • Abandoned guest accounts are cleaned up, including their data.
  • Crash reports are kept for up to 90 days. Feedback emails are kept only as long as needed to handle your request.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.html: Depending on where you live, the law may give you rights over your personal data — such as asking what we hold about you or having it deleted. You can view and delete everything yourself directly in the app; for anything else, contact us and we will help.

sections.title: 7. Children
sections.html: LiftSmart is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them. If you believe a child has provided us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.html: If we change this policy in a meaningful way we will update the date above and, for significant changes, point it out in the app. Continued use of the app after a change means you accept the updated policy.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.html: For any privacy question or request, email {{EMAIL}}.

delete.title: Delete Your Account
delete.description: How to permanently delete your LiftSmart account and data.
delete.intro: Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. All your data — workout history, plans, programs, personal records and profile — is removed from our servers. An active subscription is not cancelled by deleting the account; cancel it in your Apple Account subscription settings.

sections.title: Delete from inside the app
sections.html:
• Open LiftSmart and go to the Profile tab.
  • Scroll to the bottom of the profile screen.
  • Tap Delete account and confirm.

This deletes your training data, profile and authentication record, and for Sign in with Apple accounts also revokes the Apple sign-in token.

sections.title: Can't access the app?
sections.html: If you no longer have the app or can't sign in, email us at {{EMAIL}} from the address linked to your account and we will delete it for you within 30 days.

sections.title: What about guest accounts?
sections.html: Guest accounts follow the same in-app deletion path. If a guest account is abandoned (for example after switching to a registered account), it is cleaned up automatically together with its data.
